calibration_sources: PyTorch CUDACachingAllocator expandable_segments (cuMemAddressReserve / cuMemCreate / cuMemMap Driver API)
vAttention (Dynamic Memory Management for Serving LLMs without PagedAttention via CUDA VMM) & GMem
verl / SGLang CuMemAllocator Weight Sleep/Wake (Unmapping Physical HBM While Preserving CUDA Graph Virtual Pointers)

workload.hardware_and_workload: 64x H100 80GB SXM5 Cluster running Variable-Length Training (4K-64K dynamic sequence lengths) & RL Rollout/Serving
workload.oom_paradox: Under fixed virtual-physical cudaMalloc, 14.8 GB of free HBM scattered across 40 non-contiguous 370MB holes cannot satisfy a 2.0 GB contiguous tensor allocation
workload.mmu_mechanism: CUDA Driver VMM (cuMemAddressReserve + cuMemCreate + cuMemMap) decouples virtual address continuity from 2MB physical HBM pages

tiers.name: Tier 1: 默认分配器 + 频繁手动调用 torch.cuda.empty_cache() (触发全局 cudaFree 同步阻塞 145ms/步)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Default Allocator + Frequent torch.cuda.empty_cache() (145ms Global Sync Stall)
tiers.memory_management_stack: Calls empty_cache() -> cudaFree() on shape changes to reclaim fragmented blocks
tiers.mmu_and_kernel_behavior: cudaFree forces a device-wide synchronization across all CUDA streams, stalling GPU compute for 145ms/step
tiers.recommended_for: Never recommended inside training/serving loops; calling empty_cache() every step destroys async CPU-GPU overlap.

tiers.name: Tier 2: 标准 PyTorch Caching Allocator 固定块池 (明明剩 14.8GB 却因虚拟地址不连续直接报 OOM)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Standard PyTorch Caching Allocator Fixed Blocks (18.5% Fragmentation -> OOM at 65.2 GB)
tiers.memory_management_stack: cudaMalloc locks virtual & physical addresses 1:1; splits/merges only adjacent virtual blocks
tiers.mmu_and_kernel_behavior: Under variable sequence lengths (4K->64K->16K), 14.8 GB of free HBM is trapped in non-adjacent holes
tiers.recommended_for: Static-shape workloads only where every tensor has the exact same dimensions on every step.

tiers.name: Tier 3: CUDA VMM 虚拟内存解耦 (expandable_segments:True -> 2MB 物理页拼成连续虚拟张量)
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: CUDA Driver VMM (expandable_segments:True · Stitches 2MB Physical Slabs)
tiers.memory_management_stack: cuMemAddressReserve (virtual) + cuMemCreate (2MB/20MB physical pages) + cuMemMap (GPU MMU page table)
tiers.mmu_and_kernel_behavior: Stitches scattered physical HBM pages into contiguous virtual tensors in 15us without cudaFree or memcpy
tiers.recommended_for: Immediate 1-line env-var upgrade (PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True) for all dynamic-shape PyTorch jobs.

tiers.name: Tier 4: VMM 可扩展段 + vAttention/GMem 硬件页表连续 KV Cache + RL 保持虚拟指针零拷贝休眠唤醒
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: VMM Expandable Segments + vAttention MMU Virtual KV Cache + Graph-Safe Sleep/Wake
tiers.memory_management_stack: CUDA VMM for activations + vAttention MMU-contiguous KV cache (no software block_table) + cuMemUnmap RL sleep
tiers.mmu_and_kernel_behavior: Eliminates PagedAttention software index arithmetic (+14% attn speed) & unmaps RL weights without breaking CUDA Graphs
tiers.recommended_for: Production variable-length training, high-throughput LLM serving (vAttention), and colocated RL post-training (verl/Slime).
